title: Retrieval-Enhanced Cultural Evaluation for Social Media Translation Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.02009v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Social media translation requires preserving meaning while capturing the cultural nuances of user-generated content (UGC). However, gaps in the cultural knowledge of LLM-based evaluators can lead to inaccurate assessments and unreliable training rewards. To improve these signals, we use retrieval-enhanced cultural evaluation to train CUE-MT, a family of social media translation models. A calibrated, domain-specific Judger guides supervised data refinement and is augmented by an Agent for hard-example mining and reinforcement learning. The Agent retrieves relevant external evidence as needed and distills it into concise hints that the Judger uses to score translations and assign rewards. Across 9B, 27B, and 35B-A3B backbones, CUE-MT outperforms the evaluated open-source baselines of comparable size on CUE-MT-Bench and three public benchmarks. translated_title: 面向社交媒体翻译训练的检索增强文化评估
translated_abstract: 社交媒体翻译需要在保留原意的同时捕捉用户生成内容（UGC）的文化细微差别。然而，基于大语言模型的评估器在文化知识方面的不足可能导致不准确的评估和不可靠的训练奖励。为了改进这些信号，我们采用检索增强的文化评估方法来训练CUE-MT，这是一系列社交媒体翻译模型。一个经过校准的、领域特定的Judger（评判器）用于指导监督数据的精炼，并通过一个Agent（智能体）进行困难样本挖掘和强化学习来增强其能力。该Agent根据需要检索相关的外部证据，并将其提炼为简洁的提示，Judger利用这些提示对翻译进行评分并分配奖励。在9B、27B和35B-A3B三种骨干模型上，CUE-MT在CUE-MT-Bench和三个公开基准测试上的表现均优于同等规模的开源基线模型。在CUE-MT-Bench上的人工评估显示，文化有效性提升了7.44至15.12个百分点。
tldr: 本文提出CUE-MT社交媒体翻译模型系列，通过Agent按需检索外部文化证据并提炼为提示来增强校准后的Judger，从而改进监督数据精炼与强化学习奖励信号，在文化有效性上比同规模开源基线提升7.44至15.12个百分点。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CUE-MT, a family of social media translation models trained with retrieval-enhanced cultural evaluation, where an Agent retrieves and distills external cultural evidence to augment a calibrated Judger for data refinement and reinforcement learning rewards, achieving 7.44-15.12 percentage point gains in cultural effectiveness over comparable open-source baselines.
